title: openclare: automatic quad retopology
description:
Automatic quad retopology for Blender: a mesh of triangles in, a mesh of quads out, its edges following the shape. An open-source engine written in Rust, with a Blender add-on and a bench comparing it with other remeshers.

The release includes two research papers, not peer reviewed, under CC BY 4.0: Closing Edge Loops at Quantization Time: Helix Constraints for T-Mesh Quantization (docs/research/closing-loops: LaTeX source, figures, PDF, and a best-effort French translation), and Turns of a T-Mesh: Obstructions to Closing Edge Loops (docs/research/closing-helices: LaTeX source, figures, PDF), with the Lean 4 proofs of its algebraic cores (docs/research/closing-helices/lean, under GPL-3.0-or-later).
